rows.dermoplasm-puts-a-morph-under-the-oppone: CR 118.12: the morph card Dermoplasm puts onto the battlefield should enter under the Gather Specimens caster (p1), not under p0, because Gather Specimens replaces the entering player. Observed: Akroma entered under p0's control, Dermoplasm returned to p0's hand, and the Gather Specimens effect had no visible result.
